definition: To change or influence something (a verb).
exampleSentence: The new rules will affect every employee in the company.

definition: The result of a change (a noun).
exampleSentence: The new design had a positive effect on sales.

definition: Not tight or not firmly fixed.
exampleSentence: One of the screws on my laptop is loose.

definition: Used in comparisons.
exampleSentence: The new server is much faster than the old one.

definition: Belonging to it.
exampleSentence: The company changed its logo and website last year.

turkish: it is / it has kısaltması ≠ its: onun
definition: Short for "it is" or "it has".
exampleSentence: It's important to back up your files every day.

definition: An opinion about what someone should do (a noun).
exampleSentence: My mentor gave me good advice about my career.

definition: To tell someone what you think they should do (a verb).
exampleSentence: The doctor will advise you to rest for a few days.

turkish: ana, başlıca; okul müdürü ≠ principle: ilke
definition: Most important, or the head of a school.
exampleSentence: The principal reason for the delay was a lack of staff.

definition: A basic rule or belief.
exampleSentence: Our team follows the principle of keeping code simple.

definition: Not moving.
exampleSentence: The car was stationary when the bus hit it.

definition: Paper, pens and other office supplies.
exampleSentence: The office manager orders new stationery every month.

definition: To go well with something and make it better.
exampleSentence: The new tool will complement our existing software.

definition: Something nice you say to praise someone.
exampleSentence: The client paid us a compliment on the clean design.

definition: To make certain that something happens.
exampleSentence: Please ensure that all tests pass before you merge.

definition: To buy insurance against loss or damage.
exampleSentence: We need to insure the new laptops against theft.

definition: To give something to someone for a short time.
exampleSentence: Could you lend me your charger until tomorrow?

definition: To take something from someone for a short time.
exampleSentence: Can I borrow your pen for a moment, please?

definition: To go up by itself (no object).
exampleSentence: Prices usually rise at the start of the year.

definition: To lift or increase something (needs an object).
exampleSentence: The company will raise salaries by five percent.

definition: To be in a flat position, or to say something untrue.
exampleSentence: I need to lie down because I have a headache.

definition: Related to the economy.
exampleSentence: The country is facing serious economic problems this year.

definition: Using little money or energy.
exampleSentence: Small electric cars are more economical than large ones.

definition: A smaller number of countable things.
exampleSentence: We had fewer bugs this month than last month.

definition: A smaller amount of something you cannot count.
exampleSentence: The new process uses less paper and saves money.

definition: To suggest something without saying it directly.
exampleSentence: Are you trying to imply that I made the mistake?

definition: To reach an opinion from the facts you have.
exampleSentence: From his silence, I infer that he does not agree.

definition: Careful not to tell secrets.
exampleSentence: Please be discreet about the salary changes until Monday.

definition: Separate and different from each other.
exampleSentence: The project is divided into five discrete stages.

turkish: daha fazla, ek ≠ farther: daha uzak
definition: More or additional.
exampleSentence: Please contact me if you need further information.

definition: At a greater physical distance.
exampleSentence: The new office is farther from my home than the old one.

definition: Used to ask or say who owns something.
exampleSentence: Whose laptop is this on the meeting room table?

turkish: who is / who has kısaltması ≠ whose: kimin
definition: Short for "who is" or "who has".
exampleSentence: Who's going to present the project results tomorrow morning?

definition: Belonging to them.
exampleSentence: The developers showed their new app to the client.

definition: Short for "they are".
exampleSentence: They're working late to finish the release tonight.

definition: Short for "you are".
exampleSentence: You're welcome to join our team lunch on Friday.

definition: The air that goes in and out of your lungs (a noun).
exampleSentence: Take a deep breath before you start your presentation.

definition: To take air into your lungs (a verb).
exampleSentence: Remember to breathe slowly when you feel nervous.

definition: A large, dry area with very little rain.
exampleSentence: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world.

definition: Sweet food eaten at the end of a meal.
exampleSentence: We had chocolate cake for dessert after dinner.
